test-contact-001.summary: Marcus Thompson runs Thompson Mobile Detail, a solo mobile auto detailing business in Indianapolis serving residential and commercial customers from a van. He’s in the active Orange Corners Growth Cohort after completing the Riverside Small Business Accelerator last summer, and he’s been performing above expectations in the program. Most recently, he successfully implemented tiered pricing and adopted Jobber for scheduling/invoicing, which eliminated recent double-bookings and improved response times. He’s now at the point of trying to move beyond word-of-mouth residential work and start landing local corporate or fleet accounts.
